description: This header file declares functions related to HTTP status codes, methods, and versions, providing string conversions and retrievals for HTTP components used in the lighttpd server project.

methods.name: li_http_status_string
methods.description: Returns a string description for a given HTTP status code and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_method_from_string
methods.description: Returns the enum entry matching the given HTTP method string.

methods.name: li_http_method_string
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method as a string and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_version_string
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version as a string and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_status_to_str
methods.description: Converts a 3-digit HTTP status code to a string format.
